title: docs(qa): re-point 17 platform-checklist clauses the 17.7 pre-release runs proved stale or mis-asserted
body:
Fixes #21735
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Re-points 17 clauses on 16 items in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`. The 17.7 pre-release runs named on the card proved each one stale or mis-asserted. Every item keeps its id, area and selectors, gets exactly one `revision` bump (both rows of `integration-system.external-schema-introspection` ride one bump), and gets one `history` entry that cites the source commit and card.

No product code changes. No run record. `docs/qa/**` publishes nothing, so there is no changeset.

Each row was re-derived from source at the claim ref `316be321ef`, not copied from the card. Line numbers below are at that commit. The checklist itself carries symbol citations only, because its validator refuses `file:line`.

| # | item | clause | old → new (short) | source re-read @316be321ef | matches card? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | access-security.share-link-capability-tokens | A5 record-gone leg, step 7 | 410 RECORD_GONE → 404 INVALID_OR_EXPIRED, byte-identical to an unknown token | share-link-service.ts:923 (`if (!record) return null`), share-links.ts:128 + :228 (`invalidOrExpired()` fall-through) | Y |

| 17 | api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates | A1, step 2 | retired filter operator rejected at parse/build → green at parse/build, refused at runtime with 400 INVALID_FILTER + the prescription, listed by `os migrate meta` | filter.zod.ts:3256, semantic/17.filter-regex-options-retired.ts:30, sql-driver.ts:17392 | Y, with a nuance (below) |

## Divergences and choices worth a reviewer's eye

- **Row 13 (`cli.migrate-meta-codemod`).** The card says to replay a canonical source. Measured: over the real range `--from 17` (default `--to 18`), a canonical source shows no "Applied N mechanical change(s)" block, but it still lists the step-18 semantic advisories. `chain.ts` lists every hop's semantic entries unconditionally. So "Nothing to migrate — …" does **not** print there either. The clause asserts zero mechanical edits plus exit 0, not the success line.
- **Row 17 (`api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates`).** The full prescription reaches the wire only on a caller-authored `where`. A predicate whose provenance cannot be vouched gets the withheld "RETIRED" sentence, with the full diagnostic in the server log (sql-driver.ts `withheldFilterError`). The verify text says which shape to expect.
- **Row 9.** RUNNER.md's convention for counts that move is that the discriminator is the fact, never its digits. A literal is pinned only where the validator enforces it, as `enumSource` does. Nothing enforces this array's length, so the count is dropped from the assertion and kept as context.
- **Row 12.** The variants list gains the four subcommands it lacked: account-issuer, audit-metadata-bodies, multi-value-columns and unmapped-columns.
- `coverage.json` is untouched. No item's capability mapping moved.

## Verification (at `d52c1fe937`)

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` → exit 0: `OK — 15 areas, 270 items …; line citations: 0 survive …; symbol anchors: 652/662 resolved`. On the base `316be321ef` the same check reads 650/660. The two new anchors (`hono-plugin.ts#serverTiming`, `duplicate-record-error.ts#buildDuplicateMessage`) resolve, and the unresolved count stays at the named residual of 10.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 13 families derived. All 13 ran with exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
